name: PartyCade
summary: PartyCade is a free collection of multiplayer party games played in a web browser. One player creates a room and shares a link or a five-letter code, and the others join from their own phones or computers, either as guests or with an account. The collection includes drawing and guessing games, social deduction games, word games, comedy writing games, a card game and a property-trading board game, including Doodle Deck, Who Am I?, Impostor, Mafia, Code Words, Doodle Telephone, Punchline Duel, Bluffalo, Split Decision, Last Card and Party Tycoon. A Party Shuffle mode plays a series of random games with random rules and keeps an overall score. Players with an account earn XP, level up and can add friends. The game is available in English, German and Arabic.
